aggressive_definition: Stage III/IV or Gleason score ≥7 prostate cancer
aggressive_definition_excerpt: 284 aggressive cancer (stage III/IV or Gleason score ≥7)
study_design: Prospective nested case-control study in the Carotene and Retinol Efficacy Trial
cohort_total_n_excerpt: In a nested case-control study in the Carotene and Retinol Efficacy Trial, prerandomized serum α- and γ-tocopherol were assayed among 684 men with incident prostate cancer [375 nonaggressive and 284 aggressive cancer (stage III/IV or Gleason score ≥7)] and 1441 controls.
reason: Prerandomized serum tocopherols were evaluated in relation to incident total prostate cancer and separately defined aggressive incident prostate cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: High (≥median) compared to low serum concentrations of α- and γ-tocopherol were inversely associated with aggressive prostate cancer in current smokers (OR = 0.50, 95% CI = 0.32-0.78 and OR = 0.64, 95% CI = 0.43-0.95, respectively).
estimate_classifications.reason: The row's OR of 0.50 is explicitly the high-versus-low serum α-tocopherol estimate for aggressive prostate cancer among current smokers.

additional_estimates.comparison: Fourth versus first quartile of serum α-tocopherol among current smokers
additional_estimates.effect_excerpt: A multivariate-adjusted inverse association of serum α-tocopherol with total prostate cancer risk was observed in current smokers (OR = 0.62, 95% CI = 0.40-0.96, 4th vs. 1st quartiles).
additional_estimates.count_excerpt: In a nested case-control study in the Carotene and Retinol Efficacy Trial, prerandomized serum α- and γ-tocopherol were assayed among 684 men with incident prostate cancer [375 nonaggressive and 284 aggressive cancer (stage III/IV or Gleason score ≥7)] and 1441 controls.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
